newsitem.title: USA: Prudential Securities names Shea research head.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Securities names Shea research head.

text.p: Prudential Securities Inc said Wednesday it had named Michael Shea as director of equity research, succeeding Michael Culp, who has joined PaineWebber Group as a research director.
Prudential Securities also said Greg Smith, its chief investment strategist, would assume the added responsibility of being chairman of the newly-formed investment policy committee.

Shea, 41, has been the firm's director of institutional equity sales since 1993. He joined Prudential 16 years ago. In his new role, Shea will supervise the firm's research analysts and be a member of the company's capital finance management committee, Prudential said.
Timothy Landers, 38, the firm's senior institutional equity salesman, will succeed Shea as director of institutional equity sales, Prudential said.
Smith will help set investment direction as head of the investment policy committee and will manage the choice of the select list from the research department's single best ideas.
Prudential Securities is global securities firm based in New York. It is a subsidiary of Prudential Insurance Co of America.
